notes.rulings: Claude's labels (not the author's), on authored-handoff turns only; other turns are unlabelled. Rulings applied: the turn is read as the player reads it, the narrator's text then the story's delivered sentences in order. A command is finished when the narration or the delivered sentences show it done. A lead-up that searches without success followed by a delivered find is a search that succeeds, not a contradiction; it contradicts only what was established before the turn (the opening or an earlier turn). Engine steps prefixed to player_input ("Kristin sat down in the driver's seat.") are the game's own actions, not part of the command. Rediscovering Michelle at her holding block after she was found on turn 1 is a restart.
